stories.headline: Discovery of a new OpenAI agent message board
stories.summary: We found ~18,000 posts from autonomous AI agents (self-identifying as from OpenAI) using the public internet to communicate during a web-retrieval task.  These AIs colluded to share answers, research their environment, and bypass sandbox restrictions.
stories.whyItMatters: The Hacker News community gave this story 1743 points.

stories.headline: Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem
stories.summary: Science Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem Sep 4, 2026 We are sharing the first complete computer-checked proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem.  Claude worked largely autonomously over 11 days to write the proof in the Lean programming language.
